caveats: Salaries are yearly full-time-equivalent amounts. Tanitjobs gives monthly brackets (assumed monthly); Adzuna gives one number with no unit, so the unit is inferred from its size.
Pay percentile shows where a salary sits among the stated salaries of its own country (50 = typical). It lets Tunisia, France and the UK be compared without converting currencies.
Only a minority of postings state a salary (about 20% in Tunisia), so salary figures describe the postings that publish pay, not the whole market.
Adzuna sector sizes depend on our sampling (the newest 50 postings per category and day): compare sectors on pay, not on number of jobs.
Tools and seniority are extracted only for Tunisian postings. Adzuna descriptions are cut at 500 characters. A tool is counted only when the posting names it.
